Subject: Personal Loan Application

Dear Loan Officer,

My name is Ashley Garcia, and I would like to begin the process of applying for a personal loan. I am 61 years old and work as a Senior Project Manager at Tech Innovations Inc. I am currently on an approved medical leave, with my position protected under the Family and Medical Leave Act, and I expect to return to work on September 15, 2024.

I am planning to downsize and relocate to the Lakeview Senior Community in September 2025, and I am seeking a personal loan to help cover the associated moving and transition expenses. I would appreciate information on the personal loan products you offer, including interest rates, repayment terms, and eligibility requirements.

Please let me know what documentation you will need from me to move forward with the application. I can be reached at the address below, and I am happy to provide any additional information at your convenience.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Sincerely,
Ashley Garcia
48163 Reed Stream, North Jessicaburg, FL 87186
